question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
  FROM Track
),
boundaries AS (
  SELECT 
    (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 as short_medium_boundary,
    (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 as medium_long_boundary
  FROM stats
),
track_with_category AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds,
    t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 as duration_minutes,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds < b.short_medium_boundary THEN 'short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds < b.medium_long_boundary THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t
  CROSS JOIN boundaries b
)
SELECT 
  twc.category,
  MIN(twc.duration_minutes) as min_duration_minutes,
  MAX(twc.duration_minutes) as max_duration_minutes,
  COALESCE(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 0) as total_revenue
FROM track_with_category twc
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON twc.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY twc.category
ORDER BY twc.category
